name: Raspberries

pros.title: anthocyanin-rich berry pigments
pros.explanation: The red-purple pigment story adds a food-specific antioxidant angle.

pros.title: fuller texture helps real meals
pros.explanation: That practical fullness is one reason it can work beyond the numbers.

pros.title: sweet role is easy to understand
pros.explanation: It can be useful when sweetness is the job and the portion is deliberate.

cons.title: very short shelf life
cons.explanation: They spoil quickly, so waste and timing matter.

cons.title: tiny seeds can bother some people
cons.explanation: The seed texture is part of the fruit, but not everyone likes it.

cons.title: price swings hard out of season
cons.explanation: Fresh raspberries can become expensive compared with sturdier fruit.
